mama.name: Mama Lina
mama.story: Mama Lina came to Lae at 16 to sell kaukau. 40 years later she knows every vendor, every story.

kuri.name: Kuri
kuri.story: Kuri is 19. He sells buai to pay his sister's school fees. His dream is to own a trade store.

peter.name: Peter
peter.story: Peter fishes all night off Siassi, sails 3 hours to Lae. His fish feeds 50 families a day.
